title: Streaming Responses Made Easy
excerpt: Deliver tokens as they arrive and make your chat apps feel instant.

content.p: Users perceive streaming responses as much faster. The first token often arrives in under a second, even when the full answer takes longer.

content.caption: First token latency is what users feel

content.p: Add "stream": true to your request body. The server then returns server-sent events with one delta per chunk.
The last event includes usage. Accumulate it so you can display tokens consumed to your users.

list: Do not buffer the whole stream
Cancel the request when the user stops

content.p: With streaming enabled your app instantly feels snappier ✨.

faq.q: Do I still get the full usage numbers?
faq.a: Yes. The final chunk of the stream includes the usage object with input and output token counts.

faq.q: Can I stream with the official SDKs?
faq.a: Yes. Set stream=True in openai-python (or stream in openai-node) and iterate over the deltas.

faq.q: Do tool calls work in streaming mode?
faq.a: Yes. Tool-call deltas arrive in the same server-sent event stream as text deltas.
No. Streaming uses the same per-token pricing as non-streaming requests.
